system.description:
The character can temporarily grow or shrink in size. Choose increase or decrease at creation unless the 'Both Ways' enhancement is taken.

  • Level 1: Change up to 1 Size Rank
  • Level 2: Change up to 2 Size Ranks
  • Level 3: Change up to 3 Size Ranks
  • Level 4: Change up to 4 Size Ranks
  • Level 5: Change up to 5 Size Ranks
  • Level 6: Change up to 6 Size Ranks
